svg.title: Knowledge concentration in Delta Lake
svg.desc: A radial map of the 69 code areas in delta-io/delta with enough recent activity to measure. Each square is a code area, each circle a person, and a line joins each area to the person who wrote most of its commits in the last 12 months. The 25 areas where one person wrote at least half of those commits are highlighted.
svg.text: Each square is a code area; each circle, a person.
A line joins an area to its most active recent author.
one person wrote at least half
